verdicts.argument: The provided text excerpts do not contain the itemized list or the printed sum, so no textual evidence exists to refute the arithmetic discrepancy; the bidder's calculation stands as a valid finding of inconsistency.

The description 'fully establish and maintain' is indeed vague regarding specific facilities and duration, and no other provided text defines these parameters, so the objection regarding clarity under VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 is valid.

The text only states 'supply, lay and compact' without specifying gradation or binder content, and no adjacent position or note provides these technical details, so the finding of insufficient data is correct.

The text mentions 'licensed landfill' but does not specify waste type, distance, or specific site, and no other provided text fills this gap, so the objection regarding missing disposal specifications is valid.

The description lacks height, wall thickness, and reinforcement details, and while adjacent positions mention covers and concrete, they do not define the shaft's structural dimensions, so the finding of insufficient detail is correct.
The text for the wearing course does not specify surface class, thickness, or aggregate type, and no other provided text contains these parameters, so the objection is valid.
The description for floor insulation omits thickness and thermal conductivity class (WLS), and no adjacent position or note provides these values, so the finding of missing mandatory data is correct.

Although the text cites DIN EN 206, it does not specify the exposure class, slump, or curing requirements, and no other provided text defines these parameters, so the objection regarding missing technical data is valid.

The text refers to a 'foundation pit profile' but does not define the homogeneous zones (Homogenbereiche) required by DIN 18300, and no other provided text specifies these zones, so the finding is correct.

The phrase 'according to current technical rules' is too generic and does not specify the waterproofing system or water pressure class, and no other provided text clarifies this, so the objection is valid.
